primary_success_rule: TVD(QTensor_full, IBM) < TVD(ideal_noiseless, IBM) on at least 3 of 4 preregistered circuits
per_circuit_delta: TVD(ideal_noiseless,IBM) - TVD(QTensor_full,IBM); positive values favor Q-Tensor
secondary_control_delta: TVD(ideal_plus_readout_only,IBM) - TVD(QTensor_full,IBM); positive values show gate-noise modeling adds value beyond readout calibration

uncertainty.method: nonparametric bootstrap of observed IBM outcomes
uncertainty.strong_predictive_win: lower confidence bound of per-circuit delta is greater than zero

bitstring_normalization: IBM c3c2c1c0 display order is reversed to Q-Tensor q0q1q2q3 before comparison
rerun_policy: No circuit may be rerun because of an unfavorable scientific result. Rerun only for documented provider/job failure or incorrect shot count.
